title.zh: Active crypto address “copy and paste attack” threatens users even after major malware cleanup cut off hackers
title.en: Active crypto address “copy and paste attack” threatens users even after major malware cleanup cut off hackers

current_state.zh: The Sality botnet takedown cut off new malware delivery, but existing infections with the EggJagger crypto-address-swapping malware remain active, posing ongoing risks to users.
